text:
Experiment tracking supports linking every metric to its producing run, code, configuration and artifacts ([MLflow](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/tracking/)). Applied here: record diagnostic-source and checkpoint hashes, predictor version, category, seeds, sampled users/batches, metric definitions and perturbation settings; invalidate evidence after relevant changes. Three-draw deletion probes and ten-replicate substitution probes measure different interventions with different sampling precision. Report each separately, including aggregation, variability, replacement distribution and padding/masking behavior; neither establishes the other’s result.

Practical inference: deployment-parity auditing should check whether the saved checkpoint and generated predictor reproduce intended BERT4Rec scoring, including left padding, appended masks and final-position readout. Consumed-batch supervision replay should inspect actual training tensors, masks, targets and loss contributions; newly sampled batches cannot establish what training consumed. Neither audit has demonstrated priority or downstream impact without measurements. Bound both with preregistered batch/user limits, forward-pass counts and GPU-time deadlines; measure a small pilot, cap catalog scoring and charge failed audits to the shared budget. These are proposed controls, not experimentally established superiority claims.

Evaluate resulting fixes through a small, prespecified set of single-model trials with equal training budgets, seed 42 and the unchanged four-category macro validation HR@10 protocol: 200 users/category, 99 unique negatives, evaluation seed 42. Keep candidate identities fixed for paired comparisons; sampled rankings need not agree with full-catalog rankings ([Rendle](https://arxiv.org/abs/1912.02263)). Record every attempted trial and validation query, set a stopping rule before results, and avoid repeatedly redesigning probes around validation winners. A fixed protocol alone cannot prevent adaptive validation overfitting; limit selection opportunities and reserve untouched host test evaluation for the final choice ([Cawley and Talbot](https://www.jmlr.org/beta/papers/v11/cawley10a.html)).
